fields.Name: T219 - User Access Switch User Reloads Report
fields.Description: Exercises OnUserChanged -> loadPermissionsForSelectedUser: re-hydrating the target user's roles from MJ: User Roles and re-running GetAllUserPermissions for a non-current user. Different code branch from the initial current-user load (resolvePermissionsUser role-fetch path) and distinct from any generic grid interaction.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher next to the logo, choose 'Permissions', and stay on the 'User Access' tab. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Open the 'User:' dropdown at the top and select a DIFFERENT user than the one currently selected. Success is that the report RESPONDS to the change: a brief 'Loading permissions...' state may appear, then the domain accordion groups / summary count update to reflect the newly selected user (or a valid 'No permissions' empty-state appears for that user). If the user has assigned roles, a roles badge (user-tag icon) shows their role names next to the picker. Seeing the report re-query and re-render for the new user is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Selecting a different user in the 'User:' dropdown triggers a reload (loading indicator and/or updated summary/accordion content)
The report content reflects the newly selected user — either updated permission domain groups OR a valid 'No permissions' empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
